Execute a targeted search using the `public-text-read` capability on the official French Ministry of Agriculture website (agriculture.gouv.fr) or the French Government news portal (gouvernement.fr) for the period of September 4–6, 2026. 2. Search specifically for the terms "répartition" (breakdown), "indemnisation" (compensation), "allégements fiscaux" (tax relief), and "GNR" (agricultural diesel). 3. Compare any discovered figures against the €1 billion total to determine if the sum of the parts matches the announced headline.
